title: The Fisher Metric of the Ricci Flow Heat Kernel
summary: We introduce and study a Fisher information metric \(g^F_τ\) associated to the conjugate heat kernel of a Ricci flow \((M^n,g_t)\). This tensor measures, at a fixed scale, how the pointed heat-kernel measure changes when the base point is moved. We prove that \(g^F_τ\) is monotone in scale and satisfies \(g^F_τ\le g_t\). We relate its trace to the pointed Nash entropy and prove a matrix square identity for the Fisher defect \(g_t-g^F_τ.\) This identity gives a rigidity theorem for the equality case; on closed connected flows one has the strict inequalities \(0<g^F_τ<g_t\) at every positive…
